cruxes: Was the proposal accessible to each party? — C1/C2/C14; direct case fact.
Which exact proposition did a person accept? — C2/C7/C18; exact reply.
Is the issue factual, interpretive, value-based or permission-based? — C3; compare statements.
Was an invitation actually accepted? — C4/C16; response needed.
Which directional violation is evidenced? — C5; do not manufacture symmetry.
Did later reliance change after artifact correction? — C6; human response absent.
Are perspectives independently submitted or generated? — C8; inspect origin.
Who holds the relevant decision authority? — C9/C13/C15; participation rule.
Which exposure is reversible? — C11; inspect affected state.
Which unresolved conflict can recur under a new object or version? — C17; retain scope.
live_tests: Actual generated interpretation on new statement: “The hour is fine; I do not want mandatory preparation.” Output is “duration accepted; obligation disputed.” Proposed response offers an optional no-preparation role; it does not shorten the hour or infer laziness. This tests the deep branch’s concrete meaning check.

Actual generated acceptance record for “Yes, I can attend this one session”: one-session attendance accepted; recurring attendance unknown; homework acceptance unknown. This tests separation of remedy and exact acceptance; the record contains no invented weekly commitment.
